observedFailure: The diagnostic matches CSharp, but calling process.exit from the parallel emitter callback flushes a callback output sink and traps with0xC000001D instead of exit1. A focused ordinary CSharp print/error/exit control passes.
chosenFix: Reject the unresolved repeat count in the existing prepared-emitter diagnostic phase before LLVM output or parallel callbacks. Return a diagnostic count through the checked API, as other compiler source errors do; remove fatal source-error guards from per-expression emission.
checkedApiContract: The checked emitter returns diagnosticCount, writes the shared diagnostic text to its diagnostic stdout stage and emits no LLVM. The existing generated caller prints selection-emission-rejected when the count is nonzero. This internal API protocol is distinct from compiler CLI exit handling.
boundary: This change does not claim a general process.exit-in-parallel runtime fix.
